definitions.baseline_rss_mib: Resident memory immediately before the measured run.
definitions.process_peak_rss_mib: Maximum resident memory observed in-process across all phases; this is the authoritative process peak.
definitions.usr_bin_time_peak_rss_mib: External /usr/bin/time -v peak. It can under-report because phase-local high-water-mark resets affect the kernel value.
definitions.retained_rss_mib: Resident memory retained at the end of the measured run, relative to its baseline.
definitions.cell_aggregation: Warm-up processes are excluded. Baseline is the minimum and peak/retained values are the maxima across repetitions in each cell.
definitions.summary_aggregation: Minimum, median, and maximum across Peclet numbers and thread counts for each mesh/problem/method/scenario group.
